title: Tiny, cute pretzel
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- pretzel body: golden brown loops -->
  <!-- left loop -->
  <path d='M42 30 C22 20, 12 42, 24 54 C34 64, 44 54, 46 44' fill='none' stroke='#c8792e' stroke-width='11' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- right loop -->
  <path d='M58 30 C78 20, 88 42, 76 54 C66 64, 56 54, 54 44' fill='none' stroke='#c8792e' stroke-width='11' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- bottom cross -->
  <path d='M50 44 L42 78' fill='none' stroke='#c8792e' stroke-width='11' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 44 L58 78' fill='none' stroke='#c8792e' stroke-width='11' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- highlights to show edges -->
  <path d='M42 31 C26 23, 18 40, 27 50' fill='none' stroke='#e8a95a' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58 31 C74 23, 82 40, 73 50' fill='none' stroke='#e8a95a' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- salt specks -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='30' r='2' fill='#fff4d6'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='33' r='2' fill='#fff4d6'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='47' r='1.8' fill='#fff4d6'/>
  <circle cx='71' cy='50' r='1.8' fill='#fff4d6'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='62' r='2' fill='#fff4d6'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='72' r='1.8' fill='#fff4d6'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='72' r='1.8' fill='#fff4d6'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='1.5' fill='#fff4d6'/>
  <!-- cute face on the middle -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='33' r='2.5' fill='#5a2f0f'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='33' r='2.5' fill='#5a2f0f'/>
  <path d='M46 37 Q50 41 54 37' fill='none' stroke='#5a2f0f' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
